mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with rising equity valuations due to improved economic confidence; this leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.2% per annum signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates synchronized strength in consumer demand and production capacity, reducing supply-demand mismatch risks and supporting equity market gains over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 5.0%), a rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE < 5.0%, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained positive growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% per annum signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.2%, it indicates strong demand coupled with accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary accommodation and strong consumer demand
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average and FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising corporate profits.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO > 100, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of instances.
